observations: body L3, L4: «ازمان» at the end of L3 and «الكسوف» at the beginning of L4 are the two words of one run, broken at the end of the line; «ازمان» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.

body L6: in «كَفَّة الميزان الشَّمَالِيَّةُ» the tāʾ marbūṭa of «كَفَّة» and «الميزان» have no vowel signs, unlike «كَفَّةُ المِيزَانِ» before α. The kasra of «المِيزَانِ» touches the bowl of its final nūn.
body L9: a vertical speck (1.3 by 3.0 points) is printed after «٢٧٠.»; not transcribed.
body L15: «المتَحَيِّرَةُ» has no vowel sign on the mīm; the shadda of the yāʾ and the fatḥa of the rāʾ are printed touching (7.3 points). «الجَاريَةُ» has no kasra under the rāʾ.
body L16: «السَّيَّارَة» has no vowel sign on the tāʾ marbūṭa, «الكَوْكَبانِ» none on the bāʾ; the kasras of the final nūns of «الكَوْكَبانِ» and «السُّفْلِيَّانِ» touch their bowls.
body L17: «الثَّلٰثَةُ» is printed with the superscript alif over the lām.
body L20: «لِبْنَةٌ» has a kasra under the lām and a sukun on the bāʾ. «πλινϑίς» is printed with the theta ϑ.
body L21: «الرُّبْع» has no vowel sign on the ʿayn; it is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L22: «٦٢{5, 6}» has a 6 (its top highest at the left end) and a 2 (highest at the right end), 2.8 and 3.0 points.
body L25, L29: «١٠١–١٠٥», «٢١٨–٢٢١» (L25) and «90°–270°» (L29) are printed with en dashes (5.4-5.5 points).

body L31: «ζωδιακῷ» has no iota subscript under its first omega; «τῷ» and the last omega of «ζωδιακῷ» have it. The article ὁ and «ὁμόκεντρος» are the δ-shaped sort with the head turned to the right (the rough breathing).
body L32: «ممثِّل» has the shadda and the kasra on the thāʾ and no other vowel sign.
body L33, L34: the Persian «فلكى» ends in a yāʾ without dots; «ڭويند» has the kāf with three dots above (the gāf), as on p. 335. «باشد» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L35: the second «المرْأَةُ» has no fatḥa on the mīm, unlike the first.
body L13, L22: «οἱ», «αἱ» and «ἡμέραι» have the rough breathing, «ἐπαγόμεναι» the smooth one.
notes L1: «العُلْوِيّة» has the shadda alone on the yāʾ, with no fatḥa.
